answer: The vertex test I would run is Signed blood bike rider service with blood bike charity attestation: rides the charity recorded across years of deliveries, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so rides the charity recorded across years of deliveries stays private; the glacier is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the hollow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
